name: background-boxes

frames.best_why: Two coloured cells are lit up beside the heading, showing the hover effect and grid together.

tagline: A faint skewed grid whose cells glow pastel when the pointer crosses them.
summary: A deep navy backdrop built from a huge diagonal grid of thin cells, with small plus marks at some corners. Pointing at a cell fills it with a random pastel colour that later fades away.
appearance: A deep navy stage covered by a faint, perspective-skewed grid of thin lines with small plus signs where some lines cross. A few cells fill with pale pink, blue, yellow or green, and white centred text sits above the grid.
behaviour: At rest the grid is barely visible. Moving the pointer over a cell instantly fills it with a random pastel colour; the fill fades back to navy over a couple of seconds as the pointer moves on.
demo_content: Heading Tailwind is Awesome with the line Framer motion is the best animation library ngl.
search_phrases: grid background that lights up on hover
boxes that change color under the cursor
plus signs on a dark grid
use_when: A hero or section backdrop that should react to the pointer without holding content.
avoid_when: Low-end or touch devices: it mounts 15,000 cells and hover never fires on tap.
customise: Grid size, skew transform and the pastel palette are hardcoded; only className and other div attributes pass through.
weight_why: Mounts a 15,000-cell grid of motion divs, heavy to render.

a11y.note: The decorative grid is not marked aria-hidden, and the colour effect is mouse-only.

issues: The grid is so faint that frames 1 and 6 read as an empty dark panel.
No hover on touch, so mobile visitors only ever see the plain grid.
15,000 DOM cells make first paint expensive.
polish_why: Strong grid concept and subtle texture; the lines are so faint the effect nearly disappears.
title: Background Boxes
